entries.name: ops_working_set
entries.source: GitHub private release cbb-2026-27-shadow-ops (asset named in ops-state WORKING_SET.json current.asset)
entries.destination: /var/lib/sports-models/cbb-originator/prod (bound at /opt/sports-models/cbb-originator/app/data/prod): state/, cache/, ledger/, odds/, sync/
entries.sha256: per asset: WORKING_SET.json current.tar_sha256 at cutover (example 2026-11-01T15:44Z: ws-K20261101T154415Z-0fead8.tar 4f957207f4887badacc83c6d5dd728b59356a29a4e258dac10661e3d3f406841)
entries.transfer_method: ONE restore at cutover: python -m cbb_platform.prod.shadow_tick --restore (decrypts with CBB_OPS_ENCRYPTION_KEY; verifies tar sha256) AFTER the GitHub writer is disabled
entries.notes: AUTHORITATIVE copy is the release, NOT the Mac's data/prod/state (stale since 2026-10-22). Changes every tick: the sha is read at cutover
entries.licence_scope: COVERED for the private release; the Droplet copy needs the same scope extension

entries.name: ops_state_evidence_tree
entries.transfer_method: git clone --filter=blob:none --sparse -b ops/cbb-2026-27-shadow-state; same sparse set as the workflow
entries.notes: pushes stay normal (never force): a non-fast-forward rejection is the collision signal

entries.name: history_extract
entries.required: OPTIONAL when the full lockbox canonical is present (tick resolves either; equivalence PASS docs/PROSPECTIVE_SHADOW_HISTORY_EXTRACT_EQUIVALENCE.json)
entries.regenerable: REGENERABLE from the lockbox canonical (prod.history_extract build; manifest-pinned)
entries.transfer_method: fetched by shadow_tick --restore only if the canonical is absent
entries.notes: the licensed minimal path if the scope extension covers only the extract (then the morning refit cannot run)

entries.name: walkforward_store
entries.source: none yet (never created; no daily version exists anywhere)

entries.transfer_method: created on the Droplet: python -m cbb_platform.walkforward.daily register-opening; then include it in the backup set
entries.notes: ~0.4 GB / season growth; backed up with the working set from the first PROMOTED version onward
